title: 第二百八十六章 孤胆英雄第二百八十五章 张三的决心
slug: 斗罗之张三的逆袭人生
content_zh:
“张三！你……回来！”
朱华音的惊呼声被淹没在蜘蛛魂兽潮水般涌动的喧嚣声中。她眼睁睁看着张三的身影在施展夜隐之刃后变得模糊透明，随即化作一道鬼魅般的虚影，几个起落便冲入了那铺天盖地的黑色兽潮中！
但朱华音也知道自己现在冲进兽潮也很难全身而退，故也只能在远处观望。
张三的心脏在胸腔中狂跳，但精神却异常集中，他控制着魂力输出让夜隐之刃的效果尽可能坚持更长的时间。
所以现在夜隐之刃赋予的隐形效果并非完全体，而是让他的身形与周围环境融为一体难以被察觉。
配合鬼影迷踪步的诡异步伐，他在密密麻麻的蜘蛛魂兽缝隙间穿梭，如同游鱼逆流而上。
周围是地狱般的景象。
成千上万的蜘蛛魂兽汇成黑色的潮水，八条长腿爬行时发出令人头皮发麻的“沙沙”声。
幽绿的复眼在昏暗的晨光中闪烁，如同死亡的萤火。
空气中弥漫着刺鼻的腥臭，混杂着泥土被践踏翻起的气味。
张三屏住呼吸，紫极魔瞳全力运转，眼中紫光微闪，将周围环境的一切细节尽收眼底。他避开那些体型庞大、气息凶悍的精英蜘蛛，专挑低级蜘蛛密集但相对薄弱的区域穿行。
然而，越往兽潮中心靠近，蜘蛛的密度越大，实力也越强。
“嘶！”
一只磨盘大小的千年鬼面蛛似乎察觉到了什么，八只复眼猛地转向张三所在的方向，口器开合，一道粘稠的白色蛛丝喷射而出！
张三身形急转，鬼影迷踪步踏出一个诡异的弧度，险之又险地避开了那道蛛丝。蛛丝擦着他的肩膀飞过，粘在后方一只百年蜘蛛身上，瞬间将其裹成了茧。
好险！
张三额角渗出冷汗。夜隐之刃虽然能隐藏身形，但并非完全消除气息和动静。在如此密集的魂兽群中，稍有疏忽就会被发现。
他继续前进，速度不得不放缓，每一步都如履薄冰。
终于，在艰难前行了约百丈后，张三看到了那只庞然巨物——
血瞳鬼蛛王！

即便在成千上万的蜘蛛群中，它的存在也如同黑夜中的灯塔般醒目。暗红色的甲壳上螺旋状金色纹路在晨光中泛着幽冷的光泽，八条擎天巨柱般的长腿深深插入地面，每一步迈出都引起大地的震颤。
最令人心悸的是那八只磨盘大小的复眼，每一只都燃烧着妖异的血红火焰，仿佛能洞穿一切虚妄。
在它周围，簇拥着数十只体型各异但气息强大的精英蜘蛛，其中有那只右眼残损的五万年人面魔蛛、几只三四万年的鬼面毒蛛、还有数只背甲厚重如铠的蚀骨魔蛛。它们如同忠诚的护卫，拱卫着它们的王。
就是这里了！
张三停下脚步，隐藏在一只体型庞大的千年蜘蛛的阴影后。
从这里到血瞳鬼蛛王所在的位置，还有约三十丈的距离。
但这最后三十丈，却是整个兽潮最核心、防御最严密的地带，也是危险程度最高的地方。
直接放声音，他这边根本来不及撤退，就会被蜘蛛群撕成碎片。
他必须等待时机。
张三从怀中取出那枚金色的“录音仪”，手指悬在启动按钮上方，眼睛死死盯着血瞳鬼蛛王的一举一动。
与此同时，兽潮外围。
朱华音站在一处较高的土坡上，望着张三消失的方向，心已经提到了嗓子眼。她看到张三的身影在兽潮中若隐若现，几次险象环生，差点忍不住要冲下去接应。
但她知道自己现在不能动。
魂力尚未恢复，身体仍处于虚弱状态，贸然冲入兽潮只会成为累赘。她必须相信张三，也必须做好自己的准备——万一张三失败，她必须立刻执行备用计划，哪怕那意味着牺牲。
时间一分一秒过去，每一秒都如同一年般漫长。
蛛网镇方向传来的警钟声越来越急促，隐约能听到镇墙上传来的呼喊和惨叫。
烽火台的方向黑烟滚滚，显然还有勇士在试图点燃烽火台，但很快又被涌上的蜘蛛群淹没。
不能再等了！
朱华音银牙一咬，她准备吹奏曲目，尽可能分流一部分蜘蛛群，总比自己干等着要强。
而就在这时——

兽潮中心，异变陡生！
正所谓没有机会，那就创造机会。
张三看人家的阵型密不透风，直接就丢出一颗子母追魂胆，子母追魂胆爆炸打出了大量迷雾和钢针，杀伤了附近的蜘蛛群。
content_en:
"Zhang San! You... come back!"
Zhu Huayin's exclamation was drowned in the surging noise of the spider soul beast. She watched helplessly as Zhang San's figure became blurry and transparent after using the Night Hidden Blade, and then turned into a ghostly shadow. After a few ups and downs, he rushed into the overwhelming black beast tide!
But Zhu Huayin also knew that it would be difficult for him to escape the beast tide now, so he could only watch from a distance.
Zhang San's heart was beating wildly in his chest, but his spirit was extremely concentrated. He controlled the output of his soul power to make the effect of Yeyin Blade last as long as possible.
Therefore, the invisibility effect given by the Hidden Blade of the Night is not a complete body, but makes his body blend into the surrounding environment and is difficult to detect.
In line with the strange steps of the ghost shadow, he shuttled through the gaps between the dense spider soul beasts, like a fish swimming upstream.
It was a hellish scene all around.
Thousands of spider soul beasts merged into a black tide, and their eight long legs made a scalp-numbing "rustling" sound as they crawled.
The green compound eyes flickered in the dim morning light like dead fireflies.
The air was filled with a pungent stench, mixed with the smell of soil being trampled and turned up.
Zhang San held his breath, his Purple Demon Eyes operating at full strength, his eyes flashing with purple light, taking in all the details of the surrounding environment. He avoided those elite spiders with large bodies and fierce auras, and specifically chose areas where low-level spiders were densely populated but relatively weak.
However, the closer you get to the center of the beast tide, the greater the density and strength of the spiders.
"Hiss!"
A thousand-year-old ghost-faced spider the size of a millstone seemed to have noticed something. Its eight compound eyes suddenly turned in the direction of Zhang San, its mouthparts opened and closed, and a sticky white spider silk spurted out!
Zhang San's figure turned sharply, and the ghostly figure stepped out in a strange arc, narrowly avoiding the spider thread. Spider silk flew past his shoulder and stuck to a century-old spider behind him, instantly wrapping it into a cocoon.
What a risk!
Cold sweat broke out on Zhang San's forehead. Although the Night Hidden Blade can hide the figure, it does not completely eliminate breath and movement. In such a dense group of soul beasts, the slightest carelessness will be discovered.
He moved on, having to slow down, every step on thin ice.
Finally, after arduously walking about a hundred feet, Zhang San saw the behemoth——
Blood-eyed Ghost Spider King!
Even among thousands of spiders, its presence stands out like a beacon in the dark. The spiral golden lines on the dark red carapace glowed with a cold luster in the morning light. The eight long legs like the Optimus Pillars penetrated deeply into the ground, and each step caused the earth to tremble.
The most heart-stopping thing is the eight compound eyes the size of millstones. Each one is burning with strange blood-red flames, as if they can penetrate all illusions.
Surrounding it were dozens of elite spiders of different sizes but with powerful auras, including the 50,000-year-old human-faced demon spider with a damaged right eye, several 30,000-40,000-year-old ghost-faced poisonous spiders, and several bone-eroding demon spiders with backs as thick as armor. They are like loyal guards, guarding their king.
This is it!
Zhang San stopped and hid behind the shadow of a huge thousand-year-old spider.
From here to where the Blood-Eyed Ghost Spider King is, there is still a distance of about thirty feet.
But the last thirty feet are the core and most heavily defended area of ​​the entire beast tide, and also the most dangerous place.
If he just made a sound, he wouldn't have time to retreat before he would be torn to pieces by the spider swarm.
He must bide his time.
Zhang San took out the golden "recorder" from his arms, hovered his fingers above the start button, and stared at every move of the Blood-Eyed Ghost Spider King.
At the same time, the beast tide was outside.
Zhu Huayin stood on a higher slope, looking at the direction where Zhang San disappeared, with his heart already in his throat. She saw Zhang San's figure looming in the beast tide, and several dangers surrounded her, and she almostDian couldn't help but rush down to respond.
But she knew she couldn't move now.
His soul power has not yet been restored and his body is still in a weak state. Rushing into the beast tide will only become a burden. She must believe in Zhang San, and she must also be prepared - in case Zhang San fails, she must immediately implement the backup plan, even if it means sacrifice.
Time passes minute by minute, and every second is as long as a year.
The alarm bells coming from the direction of Spider Web Town were getting louder and louder, and shouts and screams could be vaguely heard coming from the town walls.
Black smoke billowed in the direction of the beacon tower. Apparently there were warriors trying to light the beacon tower, but they were quickly overwhelmed by the swarm of spiders.
Can't wait any longer!
Zhu Huayin gritted her silver teeth and prepared to play a piece of music to divert as much of the spider swarm as possible, which was better than just waiting by herself.
And at this moment——
In the center of the beast tide, sudden changes occurred!
As the saying goes, if there is no opportunity, create opportunities.
Seeing that their formation was airtight, Zhang San immediately threw out a Soul-Chasing Gallbladder. The Gallbladder exploded and released a large amount of fog and steel needles, killing the nearby spider swarms.
